title: Wait-repair retry: add hook-level negative tests (not adopted / adopted but not covering keeps the retry)
outcome: A hook-level test in ui/src/app-live-state-test-runs.test.tsx shows that, after a failed wait repair arms the retry, an unrelated resync whose snapshot is NOT adopted, or is adopted but below a current-server wait watermark, keeps the armed retry, which still fetches. It thereby pins the transport's `adopted &&` guard and its use of `state.serverInstanceId`.
acceptance: Wait-repair retry: add hook-level negative tests (not adopted / adopted but not covering keeps the retry) is done
